customManagers.description: server/.go-version and go.mod's go directive name the same Go release as the Dockerfile builder image; nothing tracks them out of the box, so they would sit still while the image moved

packageRules.description: One PR moves every place the Go version is written, so a released image is never built by a toolchain CI did not test
One PR moves .node-version (which every CI job reads) and the Dockerfile frontend builder image together, so a released image is never built by a Node CI did not test
